paper.title_en: Continuous-variable quantum machine learning on a programmable photonic processor
paper.abstract_en: Among various quantum machine learning algorithms, quantum kernel method has especially attracted attention due to its compatibility with noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices and its potential to achieve quantum advantage. Thus far, the quantum kernel method has been implemented only on qubit-based systems, but continuous-variable (CV) systems can potentially offer superior computational power by utilizing their infinitedimensional Hilbert space. Here, we implement the classical-data classification task with the CV quantum kernel method on a programmable photonic quantum processor, and propose extending this approach to the classification of quantum data.
